messages:
marco: Heads up — PR #9276 needs a second LGTM before tonight's cutover (T-45m). Repo owner is OOO. Link: https://git.company/redwood/runtime/pull/9276 
anya: pinging to see if this is urgent — what's changed?
marco: tiny change: bump default warmup timeout from 300ms -> 500ms to reduce intermittent OOM on cold path. Touches kv-warmup handler. Risk is slow cold starts, but should reduce failed allocations.
tiago: I can skim it, but if it's in warmup path QA should do a quick canary smoke. Do we have a rollback plan?
marco: yes — autobackout is enabled for this service; runbook: /runbooks/warmup-rollback.md. Also we can revert the cherry-pick in 1 commit.
anya: CI showed integration flake on the first run (kv-warmup-test). marco, did you re-run?
marco: yep, kicked rerun: https://ci.company/builds/12345. Rerun in progress.
deploy-bot: CI rerun started for PR #9276 — build 12346.
olivia: i'm available to do the second review if CI is green. Will take it in ~10m.
marco: thanks olivia — appreciate it.
deploy-bot: CI build 12346 passed — all checks :white_check_mark:.
olivia: left one tiny nit inline (naming). I pushed the trivial rename to the branch. behavior-wise LGTM after that.
tiago: quick read: looks fine, no edge-case regressions in the diffs I can see. Approve :thumbsup:
olivia: Approve (after rename) :white_check_mark:
marco: merging now and kicking a canary deploy.
deploy-bot: Deploy to canary scheduled in 2 minutes for service/runtime (image: release-2026-03-18).
qa-scout: Canary smoke at 25% traffic running — no errors so far, latency within SLOs.
marco: great. leaving a note for rollback window: monitor errors for 30m, then promote if stable. If we see >0.5% error increase, initiate rollback.
anya: thanks all for the quick help — glad we got a shadow approver.
marco: closing loop — merged and canary in flight. Will post follow-up CI/job links after promotion. :tada:
